issue.title: test_repair_states_dispatches_and_reports_json raises NameError: handle_agents_sync not imported after the agent sync CLI test split

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic, not intermittent: `test_repair_states_dispatches_and_reports_json` calls `handle_agents_sync(args)` at tests/agents_sync/test_cli_names.py:125, but the module imports only `handle_agents_names`. `handle_agents_sync` is defined in src/sase/agents/cli_sync.py and imported only by the sibling tests/agents_sync/test_cli_sync.py. So the node raises `NameError: name 'handle_agents_sync' is not defined` on every run. Reproduced on master cb230adb5e with `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/agents_sync/test_cli_names.py` (1 failed, 5 passed). Root cause: the c489e94f1e "split agent sync CLI tests" refactor put this repair-states test in the names module without its import. Fix: move the test to tests/agents_sync/test_cli_sync.py (it exercises `sase agent sync --repair-states`), or add `from sase.agents.cli_sync import handle_agents_sync`. Proposed by phase sase-1q5.8 (note #9, KNOWN witness 5bb3b1e84235a7b3172d59e6f5669cbb from just check tool 411fa721b0b9b807077f93a8bb1ac7d4); epic sase-1q5 did not cause it.

issue.creation_reason: The c489e94f1e test split left this node failing deterministically on master. It is a KNOWN failure in every just check, and no bead owned it; phase sase-1q5.8 proposed tracking it.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction in sase tool run check 8d8f3532b1b6f22323abb1bbd6d9da11 on 2026-10-31: tests/agents_sync/test_cli_names.py::test_repair_states_dispatches_and_reports_json failed at line 125 with NameError: name 'handle_agents_sync' is not defined, matching this task's root cause.
